lyrics:
[Intro: marching snare, low choir hum, boots on pavement]

[Hook: choir chanting, drums marching]
Walk me through the week
(Monday, Tuesday)
Walk me through the week
(Wednesday, Thursday)
Lord, I ain't asking for the mountain moved
Just walk me through the week

[Verse 1: male rap, urgent, on the march]
Five a.m., the bus stop, breath like smoke
Name tag on my jacket and I'm almost broke
I ain't been to service since the schedule changed
Sunday's when they need me on the loading range
So this is church: a bench, a route, a transfer slip
A psalm I half remember on my lip
You said the last come first. I'm holding you to that.
I'm last in every line they got. So where you at?

[Hook: choir chanting, drums marching]
Walk me through the week
(Monday, Tuesday)
Walk me through the week
(Wednesday, Thursday)
Lord, I ain't asking for the mountain moved
Just walk me through the week

[Verse 2: rap, wider, strings stabbing]
Pray for the cashier standing ten hours on a sprain
Pray for the driver, for the nurse's aide, the man out in the rain
The single dad who's learning how to braid his daughter's hair
The woman counting quarters at the laundry, say a prayer
They don't put us in the windows made of glass
But I read that book. We're in it. First and last.
A carpenter, some fishermen, a girl without a room
You've always walked with people on the morning shift. Resume.

[Bridge: drums drop, choir a cappella]
Friday, I can see you
Saturday, I rest
Sunday, if I'm working
Hear this anyway. Amen.

[Final Hook: full choir, brass, drums loudest]
Walk me through the week
(Monday, Tuesday)
Walk me through the week
(Wednesday, Thursday)
Lord, I ain't asking for the mountain moved
Just walk me through the week

[Outro: snare alone, a bus door opening, "Morning."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 87 BPM, 4/4, E-flat minor. A stomping march, heavy and determined.

VOICE: Male rapper, mid-range, urgent and clear, riding the march rhythm. A large mixed gospel choir chants the hook in unison and shouts the weekdays, and sings the bridge unaccompanied.

INSTRUMENTS: A marching snare with rolls, a deep stomping kick, a male-voice bass hum, stabbing strings, a brass section in the final hook, a sub bass, handclaps, the sound of boots.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, snare and hum. 0:14 Hook 1. 0:40 Verse 1. 1:24 Hook 2. 1:50 Verse 2. 2:34 Bridge, choir alone. 2:52 Final hook. 3:20 Outro, snare and a bus door, ends 3:38.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2004 Chicago soul-rap: big, warm and dramatic, choir and drums huge, vocal crisp.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I'm last in every line they got. So where you at?' at 1:18.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original takes faith to the club and the corner. This takes it to the 5 a.m. bus, for people whose shifts keep them out of the pews.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Tired, demanding, interceding, carried.
